name: Kisan Mouldings Limited
about: Kisan Mouldings Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of PVC pipes and fittings in India. It offers CPVC plumbing systems; free flow uPVC plumbing pipes; composite piping systems; SWR drainage systems, such as SWR pipes and fittings, Permafit SWR pipes and fittings; irrigation systems, including drip irrigation systems and sprinkler irrigation systems; and rainwater harvesting systems. The company also provides pipes comprising pipes, PLB duct pipes, conduit pipes, submersible pipes, casing pipes, rigid uPVC pipes, and HDPE pipes; fittings consisting of molded fittings, conduit fittings, and fabricated fittings; furniture products; solvent cement, rubber lubricants, and ghamela, a molded article. It offers its products under the KISAN and KML CLASSIC brand names to architects, builders, farmers, and individuals. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
